Track the movement of downpours, weather fronts and storms using the zoomable rain radar function. “Pocket Radar" forecasts for any location worldwide and displays real-time weather conditions as well as emerging patterns. 

Everything about the weather at a glance. Fast, simple and free of charge! 
A weather forecast app that accurately depicts current weather and emerging patterns.
